owner_statement: D-P5.2-PLAN-AUTH: I, mayank-admin, authorize planning, read-only repository analysis, and official primary-source research only for P5.2 Command And Situational Awareness. The authorized planning scope includes command-center operator workflows; adoption of the accepted Gujarat GIS experience under its parity-first, no-downgrade contract; bounded 2D map architecture with accessible table and list alternatives; situational overview aggregates; camera and stream coverage, health, blind-spot, freshness, completeness, and degradation projections; proposed-alert, mandatory-review, investigation, and operational-workload views; bounded time-window controls; authoritative list and detail drill-downs; department and role authorization; low-resource, enhanced-workstation, control-room, and future-server profiles; responsive and multi-monitor layouts; typed API, event, pagination, concurrency, error, and stale-state contracts; security and accessibility threat analysis; dependency evaluation; generated-only fixtures and validation; owner decision options; and a bounded P5.2 implementation and start plan. Internet research is limited to official primary technical, security, accessibility, GIS, browser, API, and standards sources. Local planning documentation, generated/static planning validation, and one local checkpoint commit without push are authorized. This does not authorize source import, product or test implementation, dependency installation or lockfile changes, backend routes or migrations, frontend or map runtime, map or tile network access, providers, cameras or media, Government or private data, models, datasets, artifacts or inference, operational alerts or actions, containers, Kubernetes, deployment, P5.3, or remote Git.
